directions.plain: You pick one week to offer a small discount. You post every day that week to remind people.
directions.title: One Week Sale for Holiday Shoppers
directions.why_for_you: Sale weeks pull extra strong for you, and your own posts held up last month even when creators went quiet.
directions.you_would_do: Post five times that sale week using mostly close-ups and a few on-hand shots.

directions.plain: You post often and spend nothing. You show the jewelry up close so people stop and look.
directions.title: Keep Posting Close-Ups Every Week
directions.why_for_you: Close-up posts get the most love from your shoppers, and your own posts held steady last month.
directions.you_would_do: Post four to five times each week with mostly close-ups and some on-hand shots.

directions.caution: Ads cost more this month, so results can swing a lot.
directions.plain: You pay to show your best posts to more people. You pick only the photos that already do well.
directions.title: Boost Best Posts to Young Women
directions.why_for_you: Your close-ups already earn strong attention from young shoppers.
directions.you_would_do: Post three to five times each week and put ad money behind your top two close-ups.

directions.caution: Last month only one of four creators posted, so this can be slow and quiet.
directions.plain: You mail jewelry to small creators who fit your style. They post wearing shots for you.
directions.title: Send Pieces to More Micro Creators
directions.why_for_you: Creator posts can bring lots of new eyes, and on-hand shots help young shoppers see the fit.
directions.you_would_do: Message twenty new creators, send pieces to up to twelve, and ask for close-up and on-hand photos.

season_note: December brings stronger demand but pricier ads with demand at 1.14 and ad costs at 1.27.
